Author's slip carried over from the last exact sequence of page 20, whose terms are in the wrong order (findings_016_020, page 20). By (2.11.6) χ(f_*O_E) = ½μ_s(D)(μ_s(D)+1)[k(s):k], by (2.11.8) χ(f_*O_{D'∩E}) = μ_s(D)²[k(s):k], and the correct sequence 0 → f_*O_E → f_*O_{D'∩E} → f_*O_{D'}/O_D → 0 gives μ_s(D)² - ½μ_s(D)(μ_s(D)+1) = ½μ_s(D)(μ_s(D)-1), the printed second line. As printed the first line equals -½μ_s(D)(μ_s(D)-1), so the printed equality is false (node, μ_s(D) = 2: 3 - 4 = -1, not 1). The second line is right. The TeX keeps the printed reading; a corrected edition applies this together with the page-20 correction.
